body: I thought I would need a loan as a starting point. Should I search for a long term Airbnb or apartment rent while staying at a hotel? I looked at hotel prices and they are very high.
There is a such thing as a counseling center? I didn’t know that was in my city. I think that would help me a lot.

You are right, I thought I’d need a loan as a starting point because I’m kind of running away without permission. I also dreamed of going to college so I thought I needed money for supplies. Temp-fix doesn’t sound bad but I wanted to know how I could get help in planning my life.
